sections.label: Decision making
sections.description: How characters weigh their options. Every choice is a weighted sum of named terms, then a softmax draw. These multiply whole families of terms.

params.label: Randomness (temperature)
params.description: Softmax temperature in utility points. Low = characters nearly always pick their top option. High = choices get noisy.

params.label: Impulsive noise
params.description: How much extra randomness impulsive characters get on top of the base temperature.

params.label: Needs
params.description: Weight of current needs (energy, social, fun, stress) in every choice.

params.label: Personality traits
params.description: Weight of stable traits (discipline, sociability...) in choices.

params.label: Interests
params.description: Weight of personal interests when choosing activities.

params.label: Goals
params.description: Weight of active goals. At 0 characters ignore their goals entirely.

params.label: Relationships
params.description: Weight of feelings toward the target person (affection, attraction, rivalry).

params.label: Memories
params.description: Weight of remembered experiences with the target person.

params.label: Learned experience
params.description: Weight of how this kind of action has gone for the character before.

params.label: Habit
params.description: Pull toward doing what you usually do.

params.label: Peer conformity
params.description: Pull toward what your friends have been doing lately (scaled by the belonging motive).

params.label: Risk aversion
params.description: Penalty on risky actions (pranks, sneaking out, asking someone out). Impulsive and confident characters feel it less.

params.label: Commitment to obligations
params.description: Pull of practices, shifts and scheduled events. Scaled by discipline and loyalty.

params.label: People considered per action
params.description: How many people a character considers as targets for each social action (bounded attention).

sections.label: Motivations
sections.description: Global multipliers on what characters want. Each character has their own motive profile; these scale everyone's.

params.label: Achievement
params.description: Grades, making teams, winning, getting better.

params.label: Social approval & status
params.description: Being seen, liked by the popular crowd, status moves. Raise it to run the social-approval experiment.

params.label: Belonging
params.description: Closeness, being part of a group, keeping friends.

params.label: Short-term gratification
params.description: Fun now over payoff later.

params.label: Altruism
params.description: Helping people, apologizing, supporting friends.

params.label: Mastery & expression
params.description: Practicing a craft for its own sake.

sections.label: Needs & condition
sections.description: How fast temporary states drain and recover.

params.label: Nightly energy recovery
params.description: Energy regained each night.

params.label: Social need drain / day
params.description: How fast the need for company builds (more for sociable people).

params.label: Fun drain / day
params.description: How fast boredom builds.

params.label: Stress recovery / night (%)
params.description: Percent of the gap to a person's baseline stress recovered each night.

params.label: Stress per school day
params.description: Baseline stress a school day adds.

params.label: Mood inertia
params.description: How slowly mood follows needs. 0 = mood is just today's needs.

sections.label: Relationships
sections.description: Thresholds that turn feelings into labels, and how feelings move. Each person has their own view of every relationship.

params.label: Friend threshold
params.description: Affection at which someone counts a person as a friend.

params.label: Close friend threshold
params.description: Affection for close friend.

params.label: Best friend threshold
params.description: Affection for best friend (also needs high trust).

params.label: Dislike threshold
params.description: Affection below which someone is disliked.

params.label: Rival threshold
params.description: Rivalry at which someone becomes a rival.

params.label: Crush threshold
params.description: Attraction at which it becomes a crush.

params.label: Affection change scale
params.description: Multiplier on every affection change from interactions.

params.label: Weekly drift without contact (%)
params.description: Percent affection fades toward neutral per week of no contact.

params.label: Weekly familiarity fade
params.description: Familiarity lost per week of no contact.

params.label: Misreading people
params.description: How badly people misread how an interaction went for the other person (empathy reduces it).

params.label: Interaction luck
params.description: Randomness in how any one interaction goes.

params.label: First impression strength
params.description: How much the first meeting sets the tone.

params.label: Classroom contacts / day
params.description: Random classmates each student brushes up against per school day.

sections.label: Social dynamics
sections.description: Groups, status, exclusion and information spread.

params.label: Exclusion tendency
params.description: How readily groups freeze out people they don't like at lunch.

params.label: Gossip appetite
params.description: Base chance a listener takes a rumor seriously.

params.label: Rumor impact
params.description: How much a believed rumor shifts opinion of its subject.

params.label: Rumor distortion
params.description: Chance a retold rumor gets exaggerated.

params.label: Source discovery
params.description: Chance a rumor's subject figures out who started it.

params.label: Status from teasing
params.description: How much low-empathy onlookers respect someone who mocks others.

params.label: Clique bond threshold
params.description: Mutual affection needed for two people to count as linked when detecting cliques.

params.label: Minimum clique size
params.description: Smallest group that counts as a clique.

params.label: Visibility vs likability
params.description: How much simply being known (vs being liked) counts toward popularity.

params.label: Party appetite
params.description: Multiplier on the appeal of throwing parties.

sections.label: Romance
sections.description: Attraction, dating and breakups among students.

params.label: Romance enabled
params.description: Turn the whole romance system on or off.

params.label: Attraction growth
params.description: How fast attraction develops between compatible people who spend time together.

params.label: Chemistry spread
params.description: How much pair chemistry varies. 0 = attraction depends only on time together.

params.label: Breakup threshold
params.description: Relationship satisfaction below which someone considers ending it.

params.label: Jealousy
params.description: How strongly partners react to flirting they hear about.

sections.label: Development & memory
sections.description: How people change: skills, confidence, interests, learning from experience.

params.label: Skill learning rate
params.description: Global multiplier on skill gains from practice.

params.label: Skill decay
params.description: How fast unpracticed skills fade each week.

params.label: Talent ceiling
params.description: How much natural aptitude raises the ceiling on a skill. 0 = anyone can reach the top with work.

params.label: Discipline focus
params.description: How much discipline improves each practice session's quality.

params.label: Confidence drift
params.description: How much successes and failures move confidence.

params.label: Interest drift
params.description: How much enjoyment and failure reshape interests.

params.label: Experience learning rate
params.description: How fast a character's expectations about an action update after each try.

params.label: Memory half-life (days)
params.description: How long it takes a memory's influence to halve. Intense memories last longer.

params.label: Max active goals
params.description: How many goals a character holds at once.

params.label: Coaches value talent
params.description: Weight of tryout performance in selection (each coach's personality adjusts it).

params.label: Coaches value effort
params.description: Weight of discipline and recent practice in selection.

params.label: Coach favoritism
params.description: Weight of the coach's personal feelings about a candidate.

params.label: Misses allowed (of last 8)
params.description: A coach or director drops someone who misses more than this many of their last 8 sessions.

params.label: Exam difficulty
params.description: Higher = lower scores across the board.

params.label: Study payoff
params.description: How much recent studying moves exam scores.

params.label: Parental strictness
params.description: Multiplier on how hard guardians react to bad grades and trouble.

params.label: Allowance
params.description: Weekly allowance multiplier (money gates outings).

params.label: Chance of getting caught
params.description: Base chance pranks and sneaking out get caught.

sections.label: History retention
sections.description: What the history keeps. Doesn't change behavior, only what you can inspect later.

params.label: Keep all decision traces for (days)
params.description: Every decision's full trace is kept this long.

params.label: Keep traces forever above importance
params.description: Decisions that led to events this important keep their trace permanently.

params.label: Keep minor events for (days)
params.description: Routine events (studied, rested) are kept this long, then folded into counters.

params.label: Keep events forever above importance
params.description: Events at or above this importance are never compacted.
